title.zh: 朝鲜TraderTraitor组织被指与币安63亿美元黑客事件有关
title.en: North Korea’s TraderTraitor linked to $6.3B Binance hack

current_state.zh: TRM Labs与Chainalysis将约63.6亿美元Binance黑客事件归因于朝鲜TraderTraitor；Binance已预留超过63.4亿美元弥补损失并正在恢复资产，约30亿美元已被冻结。
current_state.en: TRM Labs and Chainalysis attribute the ~$6.36B Binance hack to North Korea's TraderTraitor; Binance has reserved over $6.34B to cover losses and is recovering assets, with about $3B frozen.

updates.title_zh: 朝鲜TraderTraitor组织被指与币安63亿美元黑客事件有关
updates.title_en: North Korea’s TraderTraitor linked to $6.3B Binance hack
updates.what_changed_zh: TRM Labs、Chainalysis和链上调查员ZachXBT将币安63亿美元黑客事件与朝鲜TraderTraitor组织联系起来，称币安和Bitget的资金被混同后通过THORChain转移。
updates.what_changed_en: TRM Labs, Chainalysis, and onchain investigator ZachXBT linked the $6.3B Binance hack to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group, citing commingled Binance and Bitget funds moved through THORChain.

updates.title_zh: TRM和Chainalysis将币安64亿美元黑客事件与朝鲜TraderTraitor组织关联
updates.title_en: TRM and Chainalysis Tie $6.4B Binance Hack to North Korea's TraderTraitor
updates.what_changed_zh: Binance表示已预留超过63.4亿美元公司资金弥补损失，并已开始恢复用户受影响资产；报道补充了攻击手法、洗钱与冻结等细节，并称TRM与Chainalysis高置信度归因于TraderTraitor。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance said it reserved over $6.34B of company funds to cover losses and began recovering affected assets; reporting added attack mechanics, laundering/freeze details, and high-confidence TraderTraitor attribution.
updates.current_state_zh: TRM Labs与Chainalysis将约63.6亿美元Binance黑客事件归因于朝鲜TraderTraitor；Binance已预留超过63.4亿美元弥补损失并正在恢复资产，约30亿美元已被冻结。
updates.current_state_en: TRM Labs and Chainalysis attribute the ~$6.36B Binance hack to North Korea's TraderTraitor; Binance has reserved over $6.34B to cover losses and is recovering assets, with about $3B frozen.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed this week's ~$6.36B Binance hack — the largest crypto theft on record — to North Korea's TraderTraitor group, noting commingling with proceeds of the earlier Bitget exploit, while Binance said it has reserved over $6.34B of company funds to cover losses.
updates.detailed_summary_en: TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed this week's ~$6.36B Binance hack — the largest crypto theft on record — to North Korea's TraderTraitor group, noting commingling with proceeds of the earlier Bitget exploit, while Binance said it has reserved over $6.34B of company funds to cover losses.
